title: estate control release succeeds while holds or grants stand
body:
`control_release` (native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/estate/slots.rs:1180) checks only that the caller is the controller (`ensure_controller`), then writes `released: true`. Nothing refuses a release while a hold stands or a request is granted or running, so the desk can be left with live grants and no controller.

Reported by agentic-engineering-vc on hv's word in its window (AE hv decision 106 (5)), relayed by devbin-vc (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/20261119/intent-desk-defects.md, checked there on 3.4.0). Re-read by intent-vc on 2026-11-22 against main at 5f2da89ca (3.5.1): still live.
